# Pager

Header: `winui/ui/navigation/Pager.hpp`. Spec: `winui/ui/navigation/Pager.hpp`.

A pager: First / Previous buttons, a page selector ("Page [n] of N" in a [NumberBox](number-box.md#uinumberbox) or drop-down, or a row of page buttons), and Next / Last buttons.

It is made of controls it owns (Buttons, a [NumberBox](number-box.md#uinumberbox), a [ComboBox](combo-box.md#uicombobox)), each a tab stop of its own. Page indices are 0-based, and the selector shows them 1-based. The navigation buttons disable themselves on the first and last page. An unset page count is an unknown count, shown with no "of N" and no Last button. The declarative form is [ui::Pager](#uipager).

Example: 
```cpp
auto stack = std::make_unique<ui::StackControl>(ui::Orientation::Vertical);
auto pager = std::make_unique<ui::PagerControl>();
pager->set_number_of_pages(12);
pager->set_display_mode(ui::PagerDisplayMode::ButtonPanel);
pager->set_first_button_visibility(ui::PagerButtonVisibility::Hidden);
pager->set_last_button_visibility(ui::PagerButtonVisibility::Hidden);
pager->on_selection_changed([](std::size_t page) { std::println("show page {}", page); });
ui::PagerControl* observer = stack->add(std::move(pager));
observer->set_selected_index(3); // "4" underlined; fires the handler with 3

// Or declaratively:
ui::Property<std::size_t> page{0};
stack->add(ui::Pager{
    .selected_index       = page,
    .number_of_pages      = 25,
    .on_selection_changed = [&](std::size_t index) { std::println("page {}", index); },
}.build());
```

## `ui::Pager`

Navigation through a numbered collection of pages: First/Previous, a page selector, and Next/Last. Builds a [ui::PagerControl](#uipagercontrol).

[`number_of_pages`](#uipager-number_of_pages) is applied before [`selected_index`](#uipager-selected_index), so a selection past the default of zero pages is not clamped away.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::Property<std::size_t> page{2};

window.set_content(ui::Pager{
    .selected_index       = page,
    .number_of_pages      = 12,
    .display_mode         = ui::PagerDisplayMode::ComboBox,
    .prefix_text          = "Page",
    .suffix_text          = "of",
    .on_selection_changed = [](std::size_t now) { std::println("page {}", now); },
});
```

Every field, in the order a designated initializer names them:

```cpp
ui::Pager{
    .selected_index, .number_of_pages, .display_mode, .first_button_visibility,
    .previous_button_visibility, .next_button_visibility, .last_button_visibility,
    .button_panel_always_show_first_last_page_index, .prefix_text, .suffix_text, .style,
    .margin, .width, .height, .min_width, .min_height, .max_width, .max_height,
    .horizontal_alignment, .vertical_alignment, .visible, .tool_tip, .enabled, .accessibility,
    .on_selection_changed, .on_pointer_entered, .on_pointer_exited, .on_got_focus,
    .on_lost_focus, .on_key_down, .on_wheel, .control
}
```

## `ui::PagerControl`

Derives from `ui::Element`.

A pager: First / Previous buttons, a page selector ("Page [n] of N" in a [NumberBox](number-box.md#uinumberbox) or drop-down, or a row of page buttons), and Next / Last buttons.

It is made of controls it owns (Buttons, a [NumberBox](number-box.md#uinumberbox), a [ComboBox](combo-box.md#uicombobox)), each a tab stop of its own. Page indices are 0-based, and the selector shows them 1-based. The navigation buttons disable themselves on the first and last page. An unset page count is an unknown count, shown with no "of N" and no Last button. The declarative form is [ui::Pager](#uipager).

Example: 
```cpp
auto stack = std::make_unique<ui::StackControl>(ui::Orientation::Vertical);
auto pager = std::make_unique<ui::PagerControl>();
pager->set_number_of_pages(12);
pager->set_display_mode(ui::PagerDisplayMode::ButtonPanel);
pager->set_first_button_visibility(ui::PagerButtonVisibility::Hidden);
pager->set_last_button_visibility(ui::PagerButtonVisibility::Hidden);
pager->on_selection_changed([](std::size_t page) { std::println("show page {}", page); });
ui::PagerControl* observer = stack->add(std::move(pager));
observer->set_selected_index(3); // "4" underlined; fires the handler with 3

// Or declaratively:
ui::Property<std::size_t> page{0};
stack->add(ui::Pager{
    .selected_index       = page,
    .number_of_pages      = 25,
    .on_selection_changed = [&](std::size_t index) { std::println("page {}", index); },

```

PagerControl()

### clear_dirty_override

```cpp
void clear_dirty_override(DirtyFlags flags) override
```

Clears the pager's flags and every part's, shown or not, unlike [for_each_child()](#for_each_child), so a part that is shown again does not carry flags from before it was hidden.

### enabled_changed

```cpp
void enabled_changed() override
```

[is_enabled()](../tree/element.md#is_enabled) flipped, through [set_enabled()](../tree/element.md#set_enabled) here or on an ancestor, or a move to another parent. Drop any press or hover state. The element is redrawn either way. No-op by default.

## Enumerations

### PagerDisplayMode

```cpp
enum class PagerDisplayMode
```

Which page selector a [Pager](#uipager) shows.

| Value | |
| --- | --- |
| `Auto` | [ComboBox](combo-box.md#uicombobox) under ten pages; [NumberBox](number-box.md#uinumberbox) from ten, or with an unknown count. |
| `ComboBox` | "Page [drop-down] of N": a drop-down of page numbers. |
| `NumberBox` | "Page [n] of N": a [NumberBox](number-box.md#uinumberbox) the page number is typed into. |
| `ButtonPanel` | A row of page-number buttons with ellipses, the current page underlined in the accent. |

### PagerButtonVisibility

```cpp
enum class PagerButtonVisibility
```

How a [Pager](#uipager) shows one of its First/Previous/Next/Last buttons.

| Value | |
| --- | --- |
| `Visible` | Always shown; still disabled on its own edge. |
| `HiddenOnEdge` | invisible and disabled on its own edge, its room kept |
| `Hidden` | collapsed: takes no room at all |
